Only downloads image assets when asset_types filter is set

```rust title="Rust"
use crawlberg::scrape;
use crawlberg::CrawlConfig;
use crawlberg::create_engine;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() {
    let engine_config: CrawlConfig = serde_json::from_str("{\"asset_types\":[\"image\"],\"download_assets\":true}").expect("config should parse");
    let engine = create_engine(Some(engine_config)).expect("handle creation should succeed");
    let url = r#"https://example.com"#.to_string();
    let result = scrape(&engine, &url).await.expect("call failed");
    println!("{:?}", result.status_code);
    println!("{:?}", result.assets.len());
    println!("{:?}", result.assets[0].asset_category);
}
```
